name: claude-skills
description: Personal library of reusable Claude Code skills, distributed as plugins so they can be installed into any project without committing them.

plugins.name: korvin89
plugins.description: korvin89's personal skill namespace. Ships an interactive, curation-first code-review workflow (invoked as korvin89:code-review): auto-detects the diff source (PR / local branch / working tree), reads the full surrounding context, reviews in ordered passes with severity + confidence, optionally runs an independent second pass, and lets you curate which findings get posted. More skills will be added here over time.
